Step 0 of the `model-collapse` pass is finished: all four rows ran and Gate `G0` passed. There were no halts and no waivers, and I stopped before `1 Orient`.

- `Plan`: this is a first pass. `tools/inputs.py` exited 0 and read the input's three dimensions (`evidence`, `regime`, `modality`). I created `surveys/model-collapse.md` with the five empty sections and the log entry `### Pass 2026-10-12`. Its `Dimensions` line says `declared in the input`.
- `Preflight: scripts`: `tools/preflight.py` exited 0. The Graph API answered `429`, which means busy. That counts as reachable, but later scripts that use the Graph API will probably have to retry.
- `Preflight: Asta and WebSearch`: the `survey-pass` agent got an answer from all five services and wrote the `Preflight` line. I checked the line on disk against its report, logged `Tokens: Preflight: 39077`, and the plain check printed `OK`.
- `Gate G0`: passed. The log now has `Gates: G0 2026-10-12`.

Things worth knowing:

- `Brief slip`: I mistyped one status line of the "verbatim" printout in the agent's brief. I added a correction in the prompt rather than pasting the printout again. The agent confirmed it made no difference to the log line, but pasting unchanged is the cleaner habit. It's in the report as `minor`.
- `.git listing`: my first directory listing showed the folder names inside `.git`. I switched to a listing that skips `.git`, and I did not read any git history.
- `Outside calls`: I made none myself.

The full report, including what I read beyond the step-0 sections, is in `runner-report.md`.
